steps: A real typed insertion followed by one execCommand insertText range replacement emits native input events, undoes separately from prior typing, and redoes with native Ctrl+Y.

A saved BOM/CRLF TXT opens in the ordinary source editor. Automatic indentation uses its existing tabs. Real text input, backward multi-line toolbar indentation and native undo/redo preserve prior typing and set ordinary draft dirty state.
Chinese, English and Japanese controls fit a 390px viewport; language changes retain source, selection and the browser native undo/redo history.

Real Ctrl+[ / Ctrl+] and toolbar outdent handle multi-line selection; selection ending at the next line start excludes that line. Explicit two/four-space indentation on the first line keeps BOM at byte zero.
During an explicit IME composition, toolbar clicks and composing keyboard events make no text edit; legacy keyCode 229 is also left untouched. A real Tab key navigates focus without inserting text.

All editing before Save leaves source, registry, templates and assets byte-identical. Ordinary Save makes exactly one document request, retains BOM/CRLF and changes only the selected TXT source; draft becomes clean after index refresh.

Only generic source indentation and ordinary source saving are exercised. No code execution, formatter, language server, or backend build is claimed.
